title: [review] provisioning.py:567: Session not cleaned up on
description: If any step after create_br_session() fails (receive_message, send_message, or EDHOC processing), the session remains in _sessions until timeout expiry. The method should wrap the provisioning logic in try/finally to remove the session on failure, preventing resource leakage and potential DoS from accumulated orphaned sessions.
close_reason: Fixed: Wrapped provision_node() logic in try/finally to ensure session cleanup on any failure (receive_message, send_message, EDHOC processing). The finally block looks up and removes the session if it exists, consolidating cleanup logic that was previously only in the success path and ACK verification failure path.
